The event is divided into two phases. Teams compete in Phase 1, and the top-performing teams advance to Phase 2, where the difficulty increases and challenges become more complex. raw.details:
Codeverse 2.0

Codeverse 2.0 is a technology-focused competitive event that tests participants through challenging, time-bound tasks involving debugging, problem-solving, data analysis, web investigation, algorithms, and machine learning.

The event is divided into two phases. Teams compete in Phase 1, and the top-performing teams advance to Phase 2, where the difficulty increases and challenges become more complex.

Phase 1 — The Royal Mint

  • Open to all teams
  • Basic debugging, cryptography, web investigation, data analysis & algorithms
  • Interconnected challenges
  • Speed and accuracy determine qualification

Phase 2 — The Escape

  • Shortlisted teams only
  • Advanced debugging, forensics, web investigation & algorithms
  • Hidden clues, decoys and interconnected challenges
  • Teams race to complete the final extraction 

Rules 

  • Team Size: Each team must consist of 2–3 members. A participant can be part of only one team.
  • Two Phases: The event consists of Phase 1 — The Royal Mint and Phase 2 — The Escape. Only shortlisted teams from Phase 1 proceed to Phase 2.
  • Time Limit: All challenges are time-bound. Teams must submit their answers before the specified deadline.
  • Fair Play: Teams must solve challenges independently. Sharing answers, collaborating with other teams, or using another team’s work is strictly prohibited.
  • Resources: Participants may use only the tools, websites, and resources permitted by the organizers for each challenge.  

Guidelines 

  • Scoring: Points are awarded for successfully completed challenges. In case of a tie, completion time or a tie-breaker challenge may be used.
  • Technical Issues: Any technical issue must be reported to the organizers immediately. Decisions regarding technical issues and additional time will be made by the organizers
  • Disqualification: Cheating, unauthorized access, tampering with the event platform, or any unfair practice may result in immediate disqualification.
  • Organizer’s Decision: The organizers reserve the right to modify timings, challenges, or rules if required. The organizers’ decision will be final.
